v20-9.candidate: Jonathan said, “By no means shall that happen to you! For if I know for certain that evil has been determined by my father to come upon you—and if not—I will report it to you in your cities.”

v20-12.candidate: Jonathan said to David, “The Lord, the God of Israel, knows that I will question my father when the time comes a third time. Behold, if there is good concerning David, shall I not send to you in the field?

v20-21.candidate: Behold, I will send the little boy, saying, ‘Come, find the shaft for me.’ If I say to the little boy, ‘Here, the shaft is on this side of you; take it,’ come, for there is peace for you and no danger, as the Lord lives.

v20-31.candidate: For as long as Jesse’s son lives on the earth, your kingship will not be established. So now send and fetch the young man, for this one is a son of death.”

v20-36.candidate: He said to the little boy, “Run, find for me the shafts I am hurling.” The little boy ran, and Jonathan hurled the shaft and sent it past.
